title: Subexponential L1 and uniform L2 observability of nonnegative gradient-flow solutions above geometric-control time
difficulty_reason: H2: the existing arbitrary-sign Euclidean-domain spectral counterexample does not provide a positive-solution observation mechanism. The author conjugates the viscous gradient transport kernel to a semiclassical heat kernel, retains and adapts uniform Li–Yau logarithmic estimates, identifies its nonnegative trajectory action, constructs uniform observation tubes from GCC by compactness, and compares the complete positive kernel to obtain arbitrary subexponential L1 loss. Kernel smoothing and the Guerrero–Lebeau exponentially small dissipative remainder then yield a uniform L2 observation bound for every time strictly above GCC. Positivity is essential to the kernel/measure reduction; this full geometric-semigroup construction is beyond routine qualifying-level estimates. Supporting lemmas and terminal-nonnegative controllability are supplied together without extra counts.
